title: Clinical SaaS marketplace listing - health vertical preflight
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight preflight for a marketplace tile targeted at clinical SaaS customers (health vertical).

Audience:
- GTM product + content writers
- Sales engineering (clinical vertical)
- Legal/compliance (HIPAA review)
- Partner ops / marketplace onboarding engineers

TL;DR:
We need a super-compact tile and short listing copy that speaks to clinical buyers' top three constraints: patient-data security (HIPAA), deterministic latency for inference in clinical workflows, and predictable pricing for per-encounter usage. This doc contains: quick acceptance matrix, 3 tile copy variants (A/B/C), asset checklist, technical gates, launch measurement plan, and open questions.

1) Acceptance matrix (quick)
- Gate: Compliance clearance
  Owner: Legal / Security
  Criteria: HIPAA attestation + signed BAAs for partner flows; documentation for KMS/HSM integration if customer expects dedicated key control
  Evidence: Signed checklist + link to Legal JIRA (GT-918)
  Risk if missing: Must not go live in health regions / controlled markets

- Gate: Billing & SKU mapping
  Owner: Partner ops / Finance
  Criteria: SKU created, trial SKU behavior defined, free tier or credit flow specified
  Evidence: Billing SKU id, marketplace SKU mapping doc, test invoice screenshot
  Risk: Users sign up but cannot be charged / trial not provisioned

- Gate: Tile creative + copy approved
  Owner: GTM Product / Content
  Criteria: 1 hero tile (80x80 SVG), 1 landscape banner, 1 30–60 word succinct description + 3 bullet highlights; security blurbs reviewed
  Evidence: Asset folder URL + content doc version
  Risk: Tile rejected during listing QA -> delayed listing publish

- Gate: Provisioning & Trial flows tested (end-to-end)
  Owner: Marketplace engineering / Solutions eng
  Criteria: Trial provisioning works for a test org; entitlement mapping, SSO initiation, and sample inference flow (health data scrubbed) validated
  Evidence: Test org record, smoke test script output
  Risk: Bad first-run experience -> support tickets + churn

2) Tile copy variants (short, for A/B test in listing)
Variant A: "Redwood Inference — Predictable LLM inference for clinical apps"
- 30–45 word description: "Deploy clinical-grade LLM inference with predictable latency and HIPAA-friendly controls. Dedicated GPU pools, customer-managed keys, and audit logs so clinical teams can embed natural language AI into charting and triage workflows safely."
- 3 bullets (for tile): "HIPAA-attested deployments; Dedicated capacity for low-latency inference; Audit logs & KMS/HSM support"
- CTA: "Start a secure trial"

Variant B: "Fast, compliant LLM serving for healthcare products"
- 30–45 word description: "Ship LLM features in clinical workflows without tradeoffs: sub-second responses, deterministic throughput, and strict data controls. Swap models without code changes; keep costs in-check with per-encounter batching and caching."
- 3 bullets: "Sub-second responses for triage; Model rollouts & safe fallback; Cost-aware batching"
- CTA: "Request a HIPAA demo"

Variant C (concise, sales-forward): "Clinical-grade inference — SLA-backed & private"
- 20–30 word: "Private deployment options + reserved capacity with SLAs — for regulated clinical teams that need uptime, latency, and provable controls."
- Bullets: "Private VPC deployments; Reserved throughput; KMS + audit exports"
- CTA: "Contact sales"

Copy notes / do-not-say list:
- Avoid making clinical outcome claims (no "diagnose", "treat", "recommend clinical decisions") — Legal will flag.
- Use phrase "clinical workflows" rather than "medical" in marketing copy unless signoff.
- For HIPAA references, indicate "HIPAA-attested" or "HIPAA-ready" not "HIPAA-compliant" until legal signs off.

3) Asset checklist (required for listing)
- Hero icon: 80x80 SVG, transparent background (owner: design)
- Landscape banner: 1200x360 JPG/PNG (product screenshot with blurred PHI)
- 1 product screenshot: 16:9 with sample UI, all patient data synthetic or redacted (owner: solutions eng + design)
- Short description (30–60 words) + long description (250–350 words)
- 3 bullets / highlights (80 chars each)
- Security & compliance snippets (50–100 words): BAA availability, KMS options, audit log retention
- Pricing summary for tile display (e.g., "From $X / seat / month or metered per-encounter")
- FAQ snippets: integration time, support SLAs, data residency options

4) Technical gating (engineering checklist)
- SKU & trial provisioning complete (test script + sample org)
- Can initiate SSO (OIDC) + role mapping for marketplace users
- KMS integration documented; optional customer key provisioning flow validated
- Billing hooks validated (metering events emitted during trial)
- Sample inference pipeline for health data (with synthetic dataset) passing smoke tests: sequence length, latency within SLOs (95th percentile latency < 400ms for common prompts)
- Canary policy for rollout: start with dedicated small region, auto-fallback to hosted model variant if capacity constrained

5) Launch measurement & hypotheses
- Primary metrics to track in first 30 days:
  * Tile views -> click-through rate (CTR) to trial/signup
  * Trial provisioning success rate (target > 95%)
  * Time-to-first-inference (median + p95) for trial orgs
  * Support tickets created within first week (target < 10 per 100 trials)

- Hypothesis examples:
  * H1: "Adding 'HIPAA-attested' in the short description increases CTR from clinical buyers by +12%" -> A/B test A vs B copy variants.
  * H2: "Offering a contact-sales CTA vs self-serve trial reduces immediate conversions but increases MQL quality" -> compare Variant B vs C CTA flows.

6) Rollout timeline (suggested, condensed)
- Week 0: finalize tile copy & assets, legal pre-review
- Week 1: engineering test & trial smoke runs, billing SKU creation
- Week 2: list in marketplace as "private beta" to selected accounts, collect telemetry
- Week 3–4: iterate copy based on CTR and trial success; expand audience

7) Quick risk log / mitigations
- Risk: Legal flags HIPAA wording late -> Mitigation: prebook Legal review and use cautious interim phrasing ("HIPAA-attested")
- Risk: Trial provisioning failure for orgs with strict networking -> Mitigation: provide a runbook and offer guided setup with solutions engineering
- Risk: Public listing could attract regulated customers before Private deployment is ready -> Mitigation: mark listing as "private / enterprise trial only" until private deployment is fully tested

8) Open questions (to resolve before final)
- What is the agreed minimum SKU price for marketplace display? (Finance)
- Are we exposing specific audit log retention periods on the tile or in docs only? (Legal + Security)
- Which regions are considered 'health controlled' where we should enforce private-only listing? (Infra + Compliance)

9) Next steps (owners & quick actions)
- Ava Chen: lock final Variant and asset list by 2025-01-17; coordinate legal ping.
- Marcus Rivera: spin up trial org and run smoke test; attach screenshot to Jira GT-918 by 2025-01-20.
- Leah Patel: draft short long descriptions and FAQ snippets; iterate with design.
- Diego Alvarez: create billing SKU and share test invoice.

Relevant links & references:
- GT Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/GT-918 (marketplace health tile)
- Marketplace PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace/pull/582
- Slack thread (marketplace-launch): #marketplace-launch (2025-01-22)

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep copy options short — buyers scan fast. In health vertical, minimal words + precise security cues outperform longer marketing blurbs.
- When in doubt, push CTA to "Request a HIPAA demo" rather than a free trial for early enterprise customers.

TODOs: convert Variant A into final long description (250–300 words) and upload assets to /design/marketplace/health-tile/ by 2025-01-15.

-- end of draft preflight --
